title: Settings
noKey: No OpenRouter key: the AI writes no proposal.
signatureHint: Added as is at the end of each proposal.
keyHintOwn: Leave empty to keep the current key.
privacyLogging: In your OpenRouter account, keep prompt logging disabled (Settings → Privacy): that setting belongs to your account, not to this application.
privacyRetention: Email content is erased from this application after {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
privacyNoRetention: Email content is kept without limit in this application.
privacyEncryption: Passwords, OAuth tokens and API keys are encrypted in the database (AES-256-GCM).
privacyValidation: No email is sent without your explicit validation.
privacyReasons: The reasons you give when editing a proposal are visible to your organisation's administrators, who use them to improve the prompts. The emails of your personal mailbox are not.
name: Your name
nameHint: Shown to the other members of {organization}, in place of your address.
privacyZdr: Every AI request requires a provider that keeps nothing and trains on nothing. If none can guarantee it, the request fails instead of being routed elsewhere.
passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other sessions were signed out.
deleteAccountText: Your personal mailboxes are disconnected and what saras kept from them is erased; the mailboxes themselves are not touched. The prompts you created and the shared mailboxes you connected stay with the organisation.
confirmDeleteAccount: Delete your account {email}? This cannot be undone.
aiSetBy: Chosen by the administrators of {organization}, for every member.
sentWritingAsked: An email is sent to the AI only then.
sentWritingFetch: The content of each email to handle is sent to the AI at fetch.
